intro.text: A yellow-white guidespren who leads Khen, Sah and Kaladin to Revolar.

items.text: Yixli was one of many yellow-white guidespren who led the newly awakened singers towards Kholinar.

appearance.text: A tiny woman glowing yellow-white like the heart of a flame, in a flowing dress that hides her legs. Her face is narrow, with large, childlike eyes like a Shin person's. Talking with Kaladin, she stood on a translucent pillar of golden stone to meet his eyes.

personality.text: Like an honorspren, she controls who can see her, but she keeps her mind in the Physical Realm without any bond.
